CRAWLHELPER.gmtools.title: GM-työkalut
CRAWLHELPER.settings.add-gm.hint: Automatically adds the gm as a combatant when a crawl is started.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.add-gm.name: Add GM When Crawl Starts
CRAWLHELPER.settings.add-party.hint: Automatically adds all party members as combatants when a crawl is started.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.add-party.name: Add Party When Crawl Starts
CRAWLHELPER.settings.carousel.hint: Displays the crawl helper carousel tracker UI. Disable if using another combat tracker.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.carousel.name: Enabled Actor Carousel
CRAWLHELPER.settings.gm-img.hint: Image file to use as the GM portrait in the tracker
CRAWLHELPER.settings.gm-img.name: GM Portrait Art
CRAWLHELPER.settings.hide-combat-sidebar: Removes the sidebar tab for the default combat tracker.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.notify-on-turn.hint: Enables a notification and sound on players turns.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.notify-on-turn.name: Turn Start Notifications
CRAWLHELPER.settings.roll-encounter.hint: Automatically checks for encounters and rolls results from encounter table.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.roll-encounter.name: Automatically Roll Encounter Checks
CRAWLHELPER.settings.show-NPC-Health-Bar: Allows players to see the health bar percentages of monsters in the carousel.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.sound-on-turn.hint: Allows players to individually control player turn sound.
CRAWLHELPER.settings.sound-on-turn.name: Play Sound on Turn Start
The sound that plays on a player's turn.
